func SpecifierNode(node *ast.Node) *ast.Node {
 base, _ := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("WAVE15_SPECIFIER_BASE"))
 result := wave15OriginalSpecifierNode(node)
 index, kind, module, hasFirst, argument, answer := -1, 0, -1, 0, -1, -1
 var moduleNode, argumentNode *ast.Node
 if node != nil {
  index, kind = base, int(node.Kind)
  if node.Kind == ast.KindImportDeclaration {
   if declaration := node.AsImportDeclaration(); declaration != nil { moduleNode = declaration.ModuleSpecifier }
  }
  if node.Kind == ast.KindCallExpression {
   if call := node.AsCallExpression(); call != nil && call.Arguments != nil && len(call.Arguments.Nodes) > 0 {
    hasFirst = 1
    argumentNode = call.Arguments.Nodes[0]
   }
  }
 }
 if moduleNode != nil { module = base + 1; if moduleNode == node { module = index } }
 if argumentNode != nil { argument = base + 2; if argumentNode == node { argument = index }; if argumentNode == moduleNode { argument = module } }
 if result != nil {
  switch result { case node: answer = index; case moduleNode: answer = module; case argumentNode: answer = argument; default: panic("unidentified SpecifierNode result") }
 }
 path := os.Getenv("WAVE15_SPECIFIER_CAPTURE")
 if path != "" {
  record := []int{index,kind,module,hasFirst,argument,answer,int(ast.KindImportDeclaration),int(ast.KindCallExpression)}
  data, err := json.Marshal(record); if err != nil { panic(err) }
  file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY, 0600); if err != nil { panic(err) }
  if _, err = file.Write(append(data, '\n')); err != nil { panic(err) }; if err = file.Close(); err != nil { panic(err) }
 }
 return result
}
